import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.weights.weights import WeightLambda, WeightData


def _toy_reweight_func(params, metadata, events, size, shape_variation):
    """Compute the toy_reweight nominal weight and its +/-5% variations."""
    raw = events.LHEWeight_originalXWGTUP
    nominal = raw / ak.mean(raw)

    if shape_variation == "nominal":
        return WeightData(
            name="toy_reweight",
            nominal=nominal,
            up=nominal * 1.05,
            down=nominal * 0.95,
        )

    return WeightData(
        name="toy_reweight",
        nominal=nominal,
    )


ToyReweight = WeightLambda.wrap_func(
    name="toy_reweight",
    function=_toy_reweight_func,
    has_variations=True,
)
